newsitem.title: USA: North American bunkers mixed in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: North American bunkers mixed in quiet trade.

text.p: North American bunker prices were mixed in quiet trade on Thursday with weak sentiment foreseen in the East Coast ahead of resupply, players said.
In New York Harbor, 380 CST was trading between $92 a tonne and $94 a tonne, $1 below Tuesday's prices. 180 CST was largely unchanged at $97/$100 a tonne.
"On the East Coast there is a lot of resupply on the market that will soften things," said a Harbor trader.
In Houston, spot 380 CST was heard a touch just below $90 a tonne, but traders pegged the range at $90/$92, $1 below prices earlier in the week.
Norfolk was at $99/$100 a tonne for 380 CST and 180 CST was at $104/$105 a tonne.
The West Coast markets were notional. ((--Laney Salisbury, New York Energy Desk 1212 859-1631))
